description: This file defines thread management utilities within the 'cuttlefish::confui' namespace, including functions for thread naming, ID retrieval, and a ThreadTracer class that manages bidirectional mappings between thread IDs and names for debugging purposes.

classes.name: ThreadTracer
classes.description: Manages bidirectional mapping between thread IDs and thread names, providing thread creation with name tracking and debugging support.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name associated with a thread ID, defaulting to the current thread.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Retrieves the thread ID associated with a given thread name.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Associates a thread name with a thread ID, updating if already present.

methods.name: RunThread
methods.description: Creates and starts a new thread with an associated name, maintaining the thread name-ID mapping for debugging.

methods.name: GetThreadTracer
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ThreadTracer.
